final: WITH per_order AS (SELECT ordersmark, AVG(remaincount) AS avg_remain, COUNT(*) AS n FROM orderexecutions WHERE expirespot BETWEEN '2025-02-28 08:29:46.10496' AND '2025-03-13 08:29:46.068533' GROUP BY ordersmark) SELECT AVG(avg_remain) AS avg_of_order_avgs, SUM(n) AS total_executions FROM per_order
